geographic.reviewStatus: Current named courtyard/dome; clipped part of merged shrine footprint, with explicit partial building replacement.
geographic.groundContactBasis: Normal viewer DEM datum 981.3131407720962 m; working floor 1.1899544108328428 m is the median of 134 outside-campus samples at 1 m offset plus .3 m. 1053 raw campus samples span -2.8558678939205038..5.157968103347912 m. Foundation/paving follow the clipped campus; preview terrain seats that outline and 1.5 m margin. The open raw court and four estimated iwan recesses remain clear above the paving. Exact shrine paving, thresholds, stairs, basements, drains and current grade joins remain unverified.

buildingCutout.basis: Retained Q2393680 reference anchor [59.614722222,36.2875] is unchanged. Current named Gowharshad Mosque POI 17592500373595 and Persian courtyard POI/landuse 35184757341598 support the identity. Courtyard is the exact four-vertex pedestrian polygon; dome is separate 19-vertex building part 35185137727260. The map merges surrounding ranges into larger shrine buildings 35184757341590 and 35185838521529. The authored campus is their intersection with an explicit estimated mosque envelope: courtyard limits plus 14 m ranges, extending west to the mapped dome radius plus 8 m. This clipped source scope is not an exact independent mosque way. Whole-building replacement is disabled; a buildingCutout removes only this campus from merged parents and preserves surrounding shrine geometry. Heading 0.7432519684678092 radians follows the first courtyard edge: positive X northeast along the court, positive Z southeast. Main Maqsura iwan faces positive X from the western local court edge. Tower centers flank that iwan at estimated offsets, not independent map controls. Golden Imam Reza dome, Quds courtyard/pavilion, adjacent halls, libraries, streets and other shrine structures remain host content.
